leaves.name: bostLowerBoundPrinted
leaves.doc: height-fix, printed form: Bost, Sem. Bourbaki 795 (Asterisque 237, 1996), h_D(A) >= -(g/2) log 2pi (display UNVERIFIED), over the printed stable height ZInQ.HeightFix.IsPrintedStableHeight: Neron model over a field where A has semistable reduction in the sense of SGA 7 IX Def. 2.2/3.2 read over the residue fields k(p) (IsSemistableRes), omega = wedge^g Gamma(S, e*Omega^1), and the archimedean metric (i/2)^g int_{A(C)} eta wedge eta-bar as the total mass of the measure defined chart by chart (density |tau l|^2 in translated algebraic coordinates at every point), which must exist (IsPrintedMetricSq). Replaces bostLowerBound (ZInQ.HeightFix.bostLowerBound_of_printed, with uniformizationLeafAll and mumfordTorsionAlgClosed for T35 and the glue semiAbelianDescendsPerfect).
leaves.source: Bost, Sem. Bourbaki 795 (Asterisque 237, 1996): h_D(A) >= -(g/2) log 2pi, Deligne normalization (display UNVERIFIED), over the printed stable height (height-fix)

leaves.name: semiAbelianDescendsPerfect
leaves.doc: height-fix, GLUE: for a group scheme G of finite type over a perfect field k, if the identity component of G_kbar is an extension of an abelian variety by a split torus, then the identity component of G is an extension of an abelian variety over k by a torus (Stacks 04KV and Chevalley's theorem over a perfect field, Conrad 2002 Thm 1.1; locators UNVERIFIED). Gives the k(p)-form of semistability (SGA 7 IX 2.2/3.2) from the kernel's geometric form at the finite residue fields of number rings; used only by the consumer direction kernel height => printed height.
leaves.source: height-fix: descent of semi-abelian identity components from kbar to a perfect field (Chevalley over perfect fields, Conrad 2002 Thm 1.1, UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: javanpeykarPrintedMapHF
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-rebase: Javanpeykar, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014) Thm 1.1.1 in printed form at X = X0 x_K Qbar (X0 a smooth proper geometrically connected curve over a number field K, Qbar = AlgebraicClosure K): X projective (closed immersion into a projective space over Qbar), Jac(X) = W an abelian variety over Qbar representing Pic^0_{X/Qbar} with the tensor group law, V a model of W over K (V_Qbar = W), g = genusBar X = dim H^1(X, O_X), beta : X -> P^1_Qbar = Proj Qbar[X0,X1] a Belyi map of degree d (IsBelyiMap), h = height-fix's printed stable height ZInQ.HeightFix.IsPrintedStableHeight of V (sound archimedean metric defined chart by chart; Neron model semistable over the residue fields k(p)): h <= 13*10^6 * g * d^5. javanpeykar-fix's JavanpeykarPrintedMap verbatim over height-fix's height (JavanpeykarRebase.javanpeykarPrintedMap_of_fix: implied by it given T35 and Stacks 04KV). Replaces javanpeykarBound (JavanpeykarRebase.javanpeykarBound_of_printed_rebase, with constantFieldExtensionUnramifiedFinite, mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and uniformizationLeafAll_proof for T35, and height-fix's glue semiAbelianDescendsPerfect).

leaves.source: Javanpeykar, Polynomial bounds for Arakelov invariants of Belyi curves, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014), Thm 1.1.1, p. 90 (arXiv:1403.6404v1 p. 1); height identification p. 98 (arXiv section 2.3 p. 9); locators recorded by the locator audit (docs/research/locators.md row R18); over height-fix's printed stable height (javanpeykar-rebase)

leaves.name: constantFieldExtensionUnramifiedFinite
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-rebase: Stichtenoth, Algebraic Function Fields and Codes (2nd ed., GTM 254), Thm 3.6.3(a), for a FINITE constant field extension, with Stichtenoth's standing hypothesis that K is the full constant field of F: for F/K an algebraic function field (char 0) and L/K finite with F (x)_K L = FL (bijective productMap), every place of FL/L (valuation subring w containing L) is unramified over its restriction to F: a generator of the maximal ideal of w cap F generates that of w. The algebraic case used by the consumer (L = Kbar) is proved from it (JavanpeykarRebase.full_of_finite); finite_of_full gives the converse.
